title: Pool runway signal checklist (prep)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for 1:1 with Alex (infra lead) + finance sync later in the week. Want to surface signals that should trigger: more reservations, scale-backs, or short-term burst buys. This is scratchy — take, throw away, refine in meeting.

Key numbers (current snapshot):
- Committed pool: 320 vA100-equivalent GPUs (mix: 240 A100-40GB, 80 A10s)
- Avg daily utilization (tokens-weighted): 62% last 30d
- Headroom target (policy): 15% for peak SLOs, 25% for big model launches
- Current effective headroom: ~9% (observed at 03/10 spike)

Quick scenarios to present:
1) Conservative (maintain, adjust autoscale): keep commitments, tune burst policy (increase burst cap by +12 GPUs for next 6 weeks). Rationale: utilization trending up, but not sustained.
2) Moderate (add reservation): +48 A100 equiv in June to hit 15% headroom across forecasted workloads (chat burst + new embedding job). Cost: estimate sheet linked.
3) Aggressive (reserve +128): prepare for heavy PLG campaign and 2 new customers — runway to Q4. High cost, only if sales signals + legal commit.

Signals / metrics to monitor (early-warning):
- Queue length (inference queue): sustained > 120s avg over 30m
- P95 cold-start latency rising > 20% vs baseline
- Cost per 1k tokens > $X threshold for 3 consecutive days (from billing export)
- Spot preemption rate > 3% in 24h window (if using spot-like instances in dedicated pools)
- Large tail events: any single tenant >100% of allocated quota repeatedly

Operational checklist for autoscale/reservations decision: 
- Has product announced or scheduled a launch (Y/N)? Jira/PM confirm.
- Finance check: Available headroom in reserved budget this quarter? (action: Evan to verify by Tue)
- Risk: vendor lead time for procurement (if on-prem racks) or cloud GPU capacity windows. (ask procurement)
- Test: simulate 20% burst in perf/staging for 48h to validate caching, KV eviction, memory spill behavior. (Sofia owns)

Meeting talking points (1:1):
- Quick numbers (2 mins): committed, effective headroom, recent peak event summary
- Recommended move (pick scenario + why) (3 mins)
- If we recommend reservation: propose size, timing, and payback estimate (5 mins)
- Escalation/fallback: if reservations delayed, enable tighter autoscale thresholds + temporary burst pool (spot) (2 mins)

Open questions / unknowns:
- Exact traffic elasticity from upcoming marketing push — need product or growth projection numbers (ask: Hannah)
- Embedding batch job schedule: start date ambiguity (asks: ML infra)
- Vendor discount negotiation windows (procurement)

Action items (assignments):
- Evan: validate finance runway and quarterly reserved budget available (due: Tue 2026-03-16)
- Sofia: spin up 48-GPU staging burst test (A100 mix) and run stress/profile scripts, capture p99/p95 and cost delta (due: Thu 2026-03-18)
- Priya (me): draft a terse recommendation email for the exec sync (include scenario, cost, and fallback) — initial draft Wed 2026-03-17
- Alex: confirm if any contractual customer commitments demand priority capacity reservation (due: Wed)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc terse in meeting. Bring the spreadsheet with three cost scenarios (linked). If finance pushes back, propose a 3-month bridge via cloud burst credits. Keep details of quantization/packing knobs ready (these reduce cost without extra hardware).

Rough scribbles: 
- If we can push 8-bit quantization to 30% of baseline traffic we might avoid the +48 reserve. Need perf delta numbers (runbook: tbd).
- Consider per-tenant throttles during non-critical windows — discuss with product.

End of scratchpad. Will convert to meeting notes + decisions after sync.
